Thank you for your interest in contributing to `learning` (tutor).

This Contributor License Agreement ("Agreement") is based on the [Apache Individual Contributor License Agreement](https://www.apache.org/licenses/icla.pdf), adapted for this project. The project steward is **Iulian Bacalu (qtsone)** ("the Steward").

## Open Source Commitment

**learning (tutor) will always remain open source under AGPL-3.0.**

This CLA enables the Steward to offer the work under separate commercial licenses — including to power qtsone's closed-source products — while keeping the open source version freely available. This is the same dual-licensing model used by [Grafana](https://grafana.com/licensing/), [GitLab](https://about.gitlab.com/), and many other successful open source projects.

Your contributions will **always** be available under AGPL-3.0, regardless of any commercial licensing.

## Why We Need This CLA

This CLA allows the Steward to:

1. **Offer commercial licenses** for the curriculum and tooling — including use in qtsone's closed-source products — and to enterprises that cannot use AGPL software
2. **Defend the project legally** if disputes arise
3. **Keep the project sustainable** through dual-licensing revenue

It does **NOT** allow the Steward to:

- Close-source the project (the AGPL version remains open forever)
- Remove your contributions from the open source version
- Claim sole authorship of your work
